ja516:1.1: āha. Bārāṇassaṃ ahū rājā Kāsīnaṃ raṭṭhavaḍḍhano, mittāmaccaparibbūḷho agamāsi Migāciraṃ.
ja516:2.1: Tattha brāhmaṇam addakkhi setaṃ citraṃ kilāsinaṃ viddhastaṃ kuviḷāram va kisaṃ dhamanisanthataṃ.
ja516:3.1: Paramakāruññataṃ pattaṃ disvā kicchagataṃ naraṃ avaca vyamhito rājā: yakkhānaṃ katamo nu si,
ja516:4.1: Hatthapādā ca te setā, tato setataro siro, gattaṃ kammāsavaṇṇan te. kilāsabahulo c' asi.
ja516:5.1: Vaṭṭhanāvalisaṃkāsā piṭṭhi te ninnatunnatā, kāḷā pabbā ca te aṅgā, nāññaṃ passāmi edisaṃ,
ja516:6.1: Ugghaṭṭapādo tasito kiso dhamanisanthato chāto ātattarūpo si, kuto nu tvaṃ agacchasi,
ja516:7.1: Duddasī appakāro si dubbaṇṇo bhīmadassano, janetti yāpi te mātā na taṃ iccheyya passituṃ,
ja516:8.1: Kiṃ kammaṃ akarā pubbe, kaṃ avajjhaṃ aghātayi, kibbisaṃ yaṃ karitvāna idaṃ dukkhaṃ upāgamīti.
ja516:9.1: Taggha te aham akkhissaṃ yathāpi kusalo tathā, saccavādiṃ hi lokasmiṃ pasaṃsant' idha paṇḍitā.
ja516:10.1: Eko caraṃ gogaveso mūḷho accasariṃ vane araññe īriṇe vane nānākuñjarasevite.
ja516:11.1: Vāḷamigānucarite vippanaṭṭho 'smi kānane, acariṃ tattha sattāhaṃ khuppipāsāsamappito.
ja516:12.1: Tattha tindukaṃ addakkhiṃ visamatthabubhukkhito papātam abhilambantaṃ sampannaphaladhārinaṃ.
ja516:13.1: Vātasītāni bhakkhesiṃ, tāni rucciṃsu me bhusaṃ, atitto rukkham āruhiṃ, ‘tattha hessāmi āsito'.
ja516:14.1: Ekaṃ me bhakkhitaṃ āsi dutiyaṃ abhipatthitaṃ, tato sā bhañjatha sākhā chinnā pharasunā viya.
ja516:15.1: So 'haṃ sahā va sākhāhi uddhapādo avaṃsiro appatiṭṭhe anālambe giriduggasmi pāpataṃ.
ja516:16.1: Yasmā ca vāri gambhīraṃ tasmā na samabhajjisaṃ, tattha sesiṃ nirānando anūnā dasa rattiyo.
ja516:17.1: Ath' ettha kapi-m-āgañchi gonāgulo darīcaro sākhā [hi] sākhaṃ vicaranto khādamāno dumapphalaṃ.
ja516:18.1: so maṃ disvā kisaṃ paṇḍuṃ kāruññam akaraṃ mayi: Ambho ko nāma so ettha evaṃ dukkhena aṭṭito,
ja516:19.1: manusso amanusso vā attānaṃ me pavedaya. Tass' añjalim paṇāmetvā idaṃ vacanam abraviṃ:
ja516:20.1: manusso 'haṃ vasaṃ patto, sā me n' atthi ito gati, taṃ vo vadāmi: bhaddaṃ vo tvañ ca me saraṇaṃ bhava.
ja516:21.1: Garusilaṃ gahetvāna vicari pabbate kapi, silāya yoggaṃ katvāna nisabho etad abravi:
ja516:22.1: Ehi me piṭṭhim āruyha gīvaṃ gaṇhāhi bāhuhi, ahan taṃ uddharissāmi giriduggato vegasā.
ja516:23.1: Tassa taṃ vacanaṃ sutvā vānarindassa sirīmato piṭṭhiṃ āruyha dhīrassa gīvaṃ bāhāhi aggahiṃ.
ja516:24.1: So maṃ tato samuṭṭhāsi tejasī balavā kapi vihaññamāno kicchena giriduggato vegasā.
ja516:25.1: Uddharitvāna maṃ santo nisabho etad abravi: iṃgha maṃ samma rakkhassu, passupissaṃ muhuttakaṃ.
ja516:26.1: Sīhavyagghā ca dīpī ca acchako kataracchayo te maṃ pamattaṃ hiṃseyyuṃ, te tvaṃ disvānā vāraya.
ja516:27.1: Evam me paritātūna passupi so muhuttakaṃ; tadāhaṃ pāpikaṃ diṭṭhiṃ paṭilacchiṃ ayoniso:
ja516:28.1: Bhakkho ayaṃ manussānaṃ yathā c' aññe vane migā, yan nūn' imaṃ vadhitvāna chāto khādeyya vānaraṃ.
ja516:29.1: Āsito ca gamissāmi maṃsam ādāya sambalaṃ, kantāraṃ nittharissāmi, pātheyyam me bhavissati.
ja516:30.1: Tato silaṃ gahetvāna matthakaṃ sannitāḷayiṃ, mama hatthakilantassa pahāro dubbalo ahu.
ja516:31.1: So ca vegen' udappatto kapi rubiramakkhito assupuṇṇehi nettehi rodanto maṃ udikkhati:
ja516:32.1: Māyyo maṃ kari, bhaddan te, tvaṃ ca nām' edisaṃ kari, tvaṃ ca kho nāma dīghāyu aññaṃ vāretuṃ arahasi.
ja516:33.1: Aho vata re purisa tāva dukkarakāraka edisā visamā duggā papātā uddhaṭo mayā.
ja516:34.1: Anīto paralokā va dubbheyyaṃ maṃ amaññatha, taṃ tena pāpadhammena pāpaṃ pāpena cintitaṃ.
ja516:35.1: Mā h' eva tvaṃ adhammaṭṭha vedanaṃ kaṭukaṃ phusi, mā h' eva pāpaṃ kammantaṃ phalaṃ veḷuṃ va taṃ vadhi.
ja516:36.1: Tayi me n' atthi vissāso, pāpadhammaṃ amaññatha, ehi me piṭṭhito gaccha dissamāno va santike.
ja516:37.1: Mutto si hatthā vāḷānaṃ, patto si mānusiṃ padaṃ, esa maggo adhammaṭṭha, tena gaccha yathāsukhaṃ.
ja516:38.1: Idaṃ vatvā giricaro rahade pakkhalya matthakaṃ assūni sampamajjitvā tato pabbatam āruhi.
ja516:39.1: So 'haṃ tenābhisatto ' smi pariḷāhena aṭṭito, ḍayhamānena gattena vāriṃ pātum upāgamiṃ.
ja516:40.1: Agginā viya santatto rahado ruhiramakkhito pubbalohitasaṃkāso sabbo me samapajjatha.
ja516:41.1: Yāvanto udabindūni kāyasmiṃ nipatiṃsu me tāvanto gaṇḍū jāyetha addhabeluvasādisā.
ja516:42.1: Pabhinnā pagghariṃsu me kuṇapā pubbalohitā, yena yen' eva gacchāmi gāmesu nigamesu ca
ja516:43.1: Daṇḍahatthā nivārenti itthiyo purisā ca maṃ: okkitā pūtigandhena māssu orena-m-āgamā.
ja516:44.1: Etādisaṃ idaṃ dukkhaṃ sattavassāni dāni me anubhomi sakaṃ kammaṃ pubbe dukkatam attano.
ja516:45.1: Taṃ vo vadami bhaddaṃ vo yāvant' ettha samāgatā: (Dhp. v. 337.) māssu mittānaṃ dubbhittho, mittadubbho hi pāpako.
ja516:46.1: Kuṭṭhī kilāsī bhavati yo mittānaṃ idha dubbhati. kāyassa bhedā mittaddu nirayaṃ [so] upapajjatīti. Vikiṇṇavācaṃ
